products.title: Rubi Protein™ — Lemna Leaf Protein (RuBisCO)
products.material: Lemna (duckweed) leaf protein — RuBisCO, gentle aqueous extraction
products.description: Rubi Protein is a highly functional protein from Lemna, naturally rich in RuBisCO, the protein plants use for photosynthesis and the most abundant protein on Earth. Plantible grows Lemna year-round in controlled aquafarms in Texas and extracts the protein with a gentle water-based process that keeps its native functionality. It is a complete protein (all nine essential amino acids, PDCAAS 1.0) with neutral taste, colour and aroma, soluble across a broad pH range, and it foams, emulsifies and forms heat-set gels — so it can replace egg white and synthetic binders while adding protein. On the label it reads "Lemna leaf protein". In February 2026 the FDA issued a "no questions" letter on Plantible's GRAS notice for Rubi Protein. Plantible does not publish prices or minimum orders: pricing depends on volume and application — request a quote, technical data sheet or R&D sample through Aekobaba. Supplied to food & beverage manufacturers (not sold to consumers).

products.title: Rubi Whisk™ — Complete Egg Replacement
products.material: Rubi Protein (Lemna leaf protein) with clean-label, allergen-free co-ingredients
products.description: Rubi Whisk is Plantible's complete egg replacement system, powered by Rubi Protein. It delivers what formulators use eggs for — aeration, emulsification, binding, moisture retention and structure — as a drop-in ingredient, with steady supply and pricing instead of egg-market volatility and avian-flu shortages. It whips to stiff peaks in three minutes and cannot be over-whipped, sets a firm lemon curd, keeps high-oil cakes moist and helps gluten-free breads hold structure. Plantible states one 8 oz package replaces eight dozen eggs, at an estimated 20% saving against free-range eggs. Vegan and free of major allergens. Plantible does not publish prices or minimum orders: pricing depends on volume and application — request a quote, technical data sheet or R&D sample through Aekobaba. products.title: Rubi Prime™ — Methylcellulose Replacement for Meat Alternatives
products.material: Rubi Protein (Lemna leaf protein) binding system — clean-label, free of major allergens
products.description: Rubi Prime is a binding system for plant-based and hybrid meats, powered by Rubi Protein. It gives the binding and emulsification of methylcellulose but with thermo-irreversible binding, so products hold together served hot or cold, while locking in fat and flavour for a juicier bite and lower cook loss. Plantible describes it as a one-to-one methylcellulose replacement that works in non-emulsified products — extruded burgers, sausages, chicken-style nuggets and plant-based fish — with emulsified, mycelium and hybrid formats in development.
